central_question: Can a growing raw separator be replaced by an exact semantic state whose representation, discovery/compilation, JOIN, EXISTS/projection, canonicalization, replay, and verification costs all remain polynomial on the frozen family, without solver-side 2^w boundary enumeration?

frozen_positive_family.construction: Generate a full-rank affine system A x = b over the frozen w boundary bits without enumerating 2^w assignments. Split the constraints into two packets, compile each to canonical GF2_RREF, JOIN them, then existentially project the last floor(w/3) variables and canonicalize again.

evaluation_only_exhaustive_checks.rule: Enumeration is verifier-only and must be separately charged; it cannot contribute to discovery, compilation, representation choice, JOIN, projection, or theorem-complexity claims.

frozen_hostile_control.purpose: Catch the case where serialized semantic output looks compact while the current exact constructor materializes truth rows proportional to 2^w.
frozen_hostile_control.required_detection: If constructor truth-row work grows exponentially, v9 must label HIDDEN_EXPONENTIAL_COMPILATION_DETECTED rather than treating compact output as a lifecycle escape.

frozen_cost_ledger.total_paid_rule: All exercised algorithmic costs plus representation bytes and deferred debt are summed. Evaluation-only exhaustive audit is reported separately and is not allowed to masquerade as algorithmic polynomial work.
